facts_note: One day is 24 hours; shorter use is charged as a full day; weekly and monthly packages are priced on their own, not day x n. The cash deposit (VND 2-5 million by bike and contract) is separate from the rent; identity documents and the licence are checked and photographed for the contract, originals are not kept, and this is not a no-deposit service. Delivery only for weekly/monthly agreements, within 10 km of Hoan Kiem Lake, VND 50,000 per trip or VND 100,000 both ways, beyond 10 km by agreement; no airport service. Late return: VND 30,000 per hour for 1-5 hours, one extra day from 6 hours; early return does not refund unused rent. Petrol bikes are handed over with about 0.5-2 litres and come back with about 0.5-1 litre; an empty tank at return costs VND 20,000. One basic helmet is free; no raincoat for short rentals; no extra lock. The final price is confirmed on the actual bike before the contract is signed. Prices are editorial snapshots of the Vietnamese price page (read 2026-10-19); writers must not state amounts outside allowed_amounts_vnd.
